eras.name: Foundations & craft
eras.description: Food systems, record keeping, materials, hand tools and water management. Societies may borrow, rediscover or bypass particular techniques; this is not a compulsory cultural sequence.

eras.name: Mechanical & early industrial
eras.description: Reliable mechanical power, precision workshops, organised supply and bulk production. Imported plant may coexist with local craft.

eras.name: Electrified & mechanised industry
eras.description: Conventional electrical, chemical and transport industries. This is Malaspina’s current native technological envelope, with unequal national capacity and access.

eras.name: Advanced planetary industry
eras.description: Possible developments beyond established local practice: advanced electronics, nuclear energy, sophisticated materials and medicine. These entries are not automatically available anywhere on Malaspina.

eras.name: Spacefaring & high-energy systems
eras.description: Orbital and interplanetary infrastructure, compact high-energy equipment and specialised fields. Individual applications need their own scale, reliability and manufacturing records.

eras.name: Distinctive 40K branches
eras.description: Psychic engineering, warp systems, exotic xenos sciences and lost human systems. These branches are alternatives, not one universal final age or guaranteed unlock sequence.

nodes.name: Forging & casting
nodes.scope: Worked metals and cast components.

nodes.name: Industrial steelmaking
nodes.scope: Bulk structural steels and controlled foundry work.

nodes.name: Specialist alloy production
nodes.scope: Repeatable specialist steels and alloys; exact grades require evidence.

nodes.name: Workshop tools
nodes.scope: Hand tooling, fitting and repairs.

nodes.name: Machine tools & metrology
nodes.scope: Powered machine tools, gauges and repeatable measurement.

nodes.name: Interchangeable precision components
nodes.scope: Standardised components made to controlled tolerances.

nodes.name: Mechanical mills
nodes.scope: Water, wind or other mechanical drive.

nodes.name: Industrial steam power
nodes.scope: Boilers and engines for stationary and transport applications.

nodes.name: Electrical generation & distribution
nodes.scope: Generating plant and local networks; coverage is a separate record.

nodes.name: Practical chemical processing
nodes.scope: Dyes, lime, soap and other established craft processes.

nodes.name: Bulk industrial chemistry
nodes.scope: Controlled process plant and industrial feedstocks.

nodes.name: Fuel refining & specialist chemistry
nodes.scope: Refined industrial fuels and specialist chemical processes; exact products differ.

nodes.name: Aircraft operation & servicing
nodes.scope: Operate or maintain acquired conventional aircraft.

nodes.name: Conventional airframe construction
nodes.scope: Repeatable structural manufacture and assembly.

nodes.name: Aircraft engine manufacture
nodes.scope: Domestic manufacture of conventional aero engines; specialist imports may remain.

nodes.name: Boatbuilding & seamanship
nodes.scope: Local hull construction, navigation and coastal craft.

nodes.name: Powered-vessel repair
nodes.scope: Docks and engineering support for powered vessels.

nodes.name: Steel-hull ship construction
nodes.scope: Industrial shipyards; propulsion and fittings may be imported.

nodes.name: Courier & optical signalling
nodes.scope: Physical messengers, organised signals and records.

nodes.name: Wired telegraph & telephone
nodes.scope: Electrical fixed communications and exchange equipment.

nodes.name: Radio apparatus
nodes.scope: Wireless apparatus and servicing; coverage and component supply tracked separately.

nodes.name: Practical care & surgery
nodes.scope: Established care practices and treatment, without implying modern effectiveness.

nodes.name: Asepsis & organised clinical care
nodes.scope: Hygiene, sterilisation and organised medical services.

nodes.name: Clinical instruments & medical supply
nodes.scope: Conventional instrumentation and supply production; no automatic antibiotics or life extension.

nodes.name: Cultivation & food storage
nodes.scope: Cultivation, soil management, drying and storage.

nodes.name: Mechanised food processing
nodes.scope: Milling, processing and preserved provisions.

nodes.name: Agricultural machinery
nodes.scope: Powered farm machinery; ownership, repair and domestic manufacture are distinct.

nodes.name: Water channels & drainage
nodes.scope: Channels, drains and controlled water delivery.

nodes.name: Mechanical pumping
nodes.scope: Water lifting and driven pumps.

nodes.name: Municipal filtration & sewer systems
nodes.scope: Treatment and network engineering; service access is recorded separately.

nodes.name: Roads & animal transport
nodes.scope: Road construction, wagons and cartage.

nodes.name: Railway engineering
nodes.scope: Track, rolling-stock support and railway systems.

nodes.name: Internal-combustion engines
nodes.scope: Conventional motor machinery; vehicle types need their own evidence.

nodes.name: Surveying & masonry
nodes.scope: Measurement, foundations and load-bearing craft construction.

nodes.name: Industrial structural engineering
nodes.scope: Large conventional frames, bridges and engineered structures.

nodes.name: Reinforced concrete works
nodes.scope: Concrete and reinforcement supply, quality control and structural design.

nodes.name: Textiles & household crafts
nodes.scope: Weaving, clothing and ordinary household goods.

nodes.name: Factory household goods
nodes.scope: Mechanised routine production and finishing.

nodes.name: Electrical household equipment
nodes.scope: Domestic electrical equipment; affordability and grid access remain separate.

nodes.name: Conventional arms repair
nodes.scope: Maintenance of existing conventional arms; imported equipment does not imply local production.

nodes.name: Conventional arsenal production
nodes.scope: Repeatable conventional small-arms and ammunition supply.

nodes.name: Armoured-vehicle production
nodes.scope: Vehicle manufacture and integration; fleet ownership alone is insufficient.

nodes.name: Records & technical teaching
nodes.scope: Oral and written transmission, instruction and archives.

nodes.name: Technical standards & printing
nodes.scope: Drawings, reproducible standards and technical circulation.

nodes.name: Experimental laboratories
nodes.scope: Organised experimentation and instrumented testing.

nodes.name: Advanced electronics & cogitators
nodes.scope: Computing and electronic control; architecture and fabrication remain separate.

nodes.name: Nuclear energy systems
nodes.scope: Controlled nuclear energy; no established native reactors.

nodes.name: Advanced structural materials
nodes.scope: High-performance composites and engineered materials; ceramite or other named materials require specific evidence.

nodes.name: Advanced biotechnology
nodes.scope: Controlled biological engineering; no automatic enhancement programme.

nodes.name: Rejuvenation medicine
nodes.scope: Possible specialist life-extension treatments, distinct from ordinary healthcare and not presently native.

nodes.name: Advanced sensors & control
nodes.scope: Instrumented detection, targeting and control; capabilities require separate tests.

nodes.name: Industrial automation
nodes.scope: Programmable or other advanced production control; not necessarily machine sapience.

nodes.name: Orbital launch & life support
nodes.scope: Sustained access to orbit with suitable propulsion and life support; exact architecture unresolved.

nodes.name: Voidcraft construction
nodes.scope: Interplanetary hulls, drives and life-support production; warp travel is a distinct branch.

nodes.name: Compact plasma power
nodes.scope: High-energy power systems; proposed enabling capabilities are planning categories, not canon schematics.

nodes.name: Directed-energy armaments
nodes.scope: Examples include las systems; each family has independent power and production requirements.

nodes.name: Plasma weapon systems
nodes.scope: Hunter plasma families and other 40K implementations may share research without identical parts.

nodes.name: Energy shielding
nodes.scope: Void and personal protection are distinct applications; possession does not prove reproduction.

nodes.name: Gravitic engineering
nodes.scope: Lift, manipulation or specialised gravitic equipment; no automatic flight or weapon design.

nodes.name: Advanced cybernetics
nodes.scope: Integrated prostheses and interfaces; separate from copying consciousness.

nodes.name: Disciplined psychic practice
nodes.scope: Aptitude, training and traditions; may coexist with craft societies. Not a reward for industrial development.

nodes.name: Psychic engineering
nodes.scope: Psychic interaction with materials and mechanisms; each demonstrated process records its practitioners and limitations.

nodes.name: Warp propulsion & protection
nodes.scope: Propulsion, protection and navigation must be established separately. Not required for all spacefaring civilisations; Hunters have no established warp capability.

nodes.name: Aeldari psychoplastic traditions
nodes.scope: A distinct lore reference, not an automatic human unlock or known local process.

nodes.name: Necron phase & dimensional systems
nodes.scope: Distinct exotic research branch; a generic engineering pathway is not established.

nodes.name: Biotransference
nodes.scope: Necron/C’tan precedent; not simply the next level of cybernetics or a guaranteed reversible procedure.

nodes.name: STC systems & retained design libraries
nodes.scope: Knowledge repositories and production systems are assets, not an age or an automatic prerequisite for invention.

nodes.name: Artificial machine intellect
nodes.scope: A separate branch with faction-specific implementations and restrictions; neither mandatory nor locally established.
